title: Infinity, founded by Jeremy Nixon, the creator of hacker network community AGI House, to build an inference library that runs on all chips, raised a $15M seed (Dominic-Madori Davis/TechCrunch)
summary: Dominic-Madori Davis / TechCrunch: Infinity, founded by Jeremy Nixon, the creator of hacker network community AGI House, to build an inference library that runs on all chips, raised a $15M seed — AI infrastructure company Infinity announced a $15 million raise at a $100 million valuation on Monday from investors including Touring Capital …
